purpose: Turn both preserved songs into operational continuity constraints and manually construct the first source-bounded We Walk Well chorus clause, vocabulary, and first-person-plural grammar.

manual_language_work.authoring_method: Interactive language-model judgment over reviewed source evidence, project goals, and line-level creative continuity. No script or external model selected the forms, meanings, morphology, semantic allocation, or clause analysis.
manual_language_work.automation_boundary: Local code validates schema, source-text identity, orthographic reversibility, dependencies, declared construction behavior, and cost gates only.

mixed_word.meaning: benevolent or ethically good inner disposition; goodwill
mixed_word.boundary: A listed regional-positive plus Hebrew-inner-heart formation with word-specific l-l reduction; it establishes no general compound or reduction rule.

limited_first_plural_paradigm.realization: careful contact morphography, not a Moraviantown Munsee surface prediction
limited_first_plural_paradigm.tam_boundary: The construction contributes participant, number, and clusivity only; it supplies no tense, aspect, or modality.

clauses.continuity_translation: We walk well, with good hearts.
clauses.status: provisional chorus kernel pending owner and metrical review

source_honesty: O'Meara supports the listed naxkooh(ə)meew analysis and short gloss he sings; vocal sing is a project semantic allocation and metallic ring remains excluded.
O'Meara supports the discontinuous AI independent first-plural cells; transparent long-vowel realization is contact design.
BDB supports the bounded Biblical Hebrew inner-person and moral-character range of לֵב² and physical-light senses 1 and 6 of אוֹר²; it does not attest wəlew or the contact clause.
The songs guide continuity and priority but never serve as linguistic attestation.

open_construction_gaps: road-given illumination and its first-person-plural object relation
ordinary spoken realization, stress, meter, and owner lyric review
wayyiqtol-derived foreground chaining, weqatal-derived recurrence, obviation, and multiple-obviative recovery remain later narrative work

mutation_coverage: duplicate and semantically false coverage links
